findings.source: solady EnumerableSetLib.sol:41-50 rootSlot = keccak256(set.slot . 0x978aab92 (4 bytes)); positionSlot = keccak256(value . rootSlot); values at rootSlot + i; the contract has no state variable in slots 0-2
findings.issue: The set's root slot keccak(base ‖ 4-byte seed) is printed as a Vyper-style mapping keyed by a one-element concat, which makes the whole layout 'def storage (vyper)'; the position slot keccak(value ‖ root) and root + 1 / root + 2 are printed three ways, two of them as phantom variables at storage 0, 1 and 2 indexed by a hash. The same set therefore reads as four unrelated variables.
findings.rule: A keccak whose input is a constant slot followed by a constant shorter than 32 bytes is a derived constant slot R, not a mapping access: bind R once and print R + i as R[i]; keccak(k ‖ R) is the mapping rooted at R ('R[k]'); never turn stor[H + c] with H a hash into a variable at slot c. Infer a Vyper layout only from keys of 32 bytes placed after the slot.

findings.issue: The loop test printed is a revert guard of the next element (signer != 0, value != the zero sentinel), while the real bound i < len is tested at the bottom of the body and duplicated into every exit path (each with its own final threshold check, log and stop); the first iteration's guard is peeled before the loop. findings.rule: Choose as loop condition the test on the induction variable (t + 1 < len, i.e. i < len after the increment) and keep guards that exit to a revert inside the body; a test of element i+1 done at the end of iteration i plus the same test of element 0 before the loop is the guard of element i at the top of the body.

notes: Reviewed against EtherFiSafeCore/Base, MultiSig, ModuleManager, RecoveryManager, TradingSafe, ArrayDeDupLib, EnumerableAddressWhitelistLib, SignatureUtils, solady EnumerableSetLib (AddressSet length/contains/add/remove/values/at) and OZ ECDSA/EIP712Upgradeable/SafeERC20 (the pack has no 'Reaches' lists for this contract). Read line by line: cancelNonce (whole: _currentOwner with values()/remove/_configureAdmin/add, _useNonce, EIP-712 domain separator with the two storage strings, checkSignatures with checkDuplicates, ECDSA.tryRecover error codes 1/2/3 and the ERC-1271 path, incoming-owner path), the getters, isOwner, isModuleEnabled, useNonce, isRecoverySigner, getModules, getOwners, getRecoverySigners, getAdmins, isAdmin, eip712Domain, execTransactionFromModule (hooks are view, so STATICCALL is right), redirectToTopUp. The other signature-checked functions share these blocks and were reviewed by structure (effects, logs, storage writes, loop shapes; tails of setRecoveryThreshold, toggleRecoveryEnabled and recoverSafe followed in full, including the checked block.timestamp + delay). AccountRecovered is emitted with 0 (after the delete) in the source too. Loops: 15 real source loops (initialize, getAdmins, execTransactionFromModule, _setupModules, configureModules, _configureModules, _setupMultiSig, checkSignatures, _currentOwner, recoverSafe, getRecoverySigners, checkDuplicates outer and inner, EnumerableAddressWhitelistLib.configure, solady values()) all shown as while in every inlined copy; 5 solady Yul 'for {} 1 {} {... break}' blocks (length, contains, add, remove, values outer) run at most once and are shown as straight code (counted unrolled). Implicit: 65 ABI-encode loops as while (P7), calldata array decodes with validation. P4 counts the concat(Bytes(4, seed)) keys (first finding). P1: storage-slot constants and error selectors factored by 3600 (0x2cb721...*3600 = InvalidSignatures()). 142 reverts print custom errors that are in the ABI as raw selectors (EmptySigners, InsufficientSigners, DuplicateElementFound, InvalidSigner, InvalidSignatures, OnlyModules...) - error database gap, not a decompiler error. P11: in-loop Panic(50) checks implied by the loop bound, 'require -s + t >=′ 32' (always 32), the threshold re-check after 'u + 1 == threshold', Panic(34) string-encoding checks done twice. dataProvider is an immutable read as 0 (artifact, const dataProvider = 0). No execution run: no semantic suspicion remained.
summary: Faithful on every path read, with all loops present, but hard to read: solady's set storage is shown as a Vyper-style mapping plus phantom slot-0/1/2 variables, memory at the free pointer hides every struct hash, 230 custom-error reverts and 39 events, and the signature loop is rotated so that a revert guard becomes its condition.
